argument_macro_structure.premise_explicitness: Mostly implicit, reconstructed from analogical reasoning and modal claims

argumentative_quality.dialectical_reasonableness: High: engages with the target view's own commitments and analogy
argumentative_quality.logical_relevance: High: all premises bear directly on the coherence of emergent dualism across hiatuses
argumentative_quality.premise_acceptability: Moderate: relies on ordinary intuitions about personal identity and theological constraints that may be contested

explicit_definitions_given: Emergent field: a causally efficacious mental field generated by the brain
Hiatus: a period of cessation or severe disruption of the generating physical base
Occasionalism: the view that the physical base is merely the occasion for divine instantiation of the field

dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: No explicit objections to the critique are considered; the text presents the trilemma as decisive
objections_raised: Abandoning field criterion collapses into physicalism
Accepting identity loss is counterintuitive, ethically devastating, and theologically incompatible
Invoking divine intervention collapses into Cartesian substance dualism/occasionalism

method_and_evidence.evidence_type: Conceptual analysis, analogical reasoning, theological consistency, intuitive counterexamples

philosophical_orientation.sentiment: Critical of emergent dualism; sympathetic to physicalist or substance-dualist alternatives only insofar as they avoid the trilemma
philosophical_orientation.thematic_focus: Personal identity, mind-body problem, mental causation, resurrection

structural_organization.structure_type: Problem-driven trilemma with escalating repetition and cumulative conclusion

summary_of_core_decisions: The text reconstructs Hasker's emergent dualism as committed to (1) the field as criterion of personal identity and (2) the field's dependence on the brain. It then shows that any hiatus in consciousness forces a choice among three unacceptable options, thereby undermining the coherence of the view.

thesis_commitment.hedging_density_in_final_paragraph: Low: the conclusion is stated as decisive failure for Hasker's model across hiatuses
